fields: cols [row label, use 1 … use n] (2 to 6 uses), rows ([industry string or {t, link}, cell …]; a cell "—" or "-" or "" is a blank), intro.
best_for: UseMatrix shows an industry-by-use table as one water main: a twin-wall pipe runs along the column heads and tees down into every use column, and each cell is a square on its column's line, navy where a grade is set and open where the cell is a dash.

block.intro: The minimum grade at each use, and who sets it; a dash where no grade is set. Your specification can go higher. Lab cells: the grade each test method names.
